description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
